offering_description.value: Develops and commercializes targeted cancer therapies, mainly the oral HER2-targeted drug neratinib for breast cancer. Sells to specialty pharmacies and distributors that supply patients and oncology providers. Drug manufacturing is outsourced to contract manufacturers.

primary_products.value: oral HER2-targeted breast cancer drug; investigational oncology drugs

customer_segment.value: B2B: specialty pharmacies and specialty distributors serving oncology patients; B2C: breast cancer patients treated with prescribed drug

revenue_model.value: product sales: net sales of neratinib to specialty pharmacies and distributors; licensing or royalties: royalties and milestones from licensees for neratinib outside the US

value_chain_position.value: brand owner: develops and markets drugs made by contract manufacturers, sold to specialty pharmacies and distributors

geography_served.value: global: US direct sales, licensed partners cover Europe, Asia, Latin America and other regions

specialization.value: niche specialist: oncology drugs centered on neratinib and a small pipeline

distribution_channels.value: distributors / dealers: specialty distributors and specialty pharmacies; partners / resellers: licensees commercializing neratinib outside the US

regulatory_exposure.value: high: prescription drugs requiring FDA and foreign regulator approval, clinical trial and marketing rules
